title: Simply for PET - Test 2 - Part 3 (Gap Fill)
instruction: Nghe và điền một hoặc hai từ, một số, một ngày hoặc một giờ vào mỗi chỗ trống.
fullScript:
Questions 14-19.
Man: Good morning everyone. I want to tell you about the school trip to the castle next week.

Question 14.
The coach will be leaving the school at 9.10 so you all need to be there at 8.40 and no later. If anyone is late we will not wait for you.

Question 15.
We will be doing all sorts of activities during the day but don't forget that you will be doing a project on the castle so you need to bring a book, I mean a notebook with you. Don't worry about bringing a camera as on the last trip two people lost their cameras. You can always use your phones if you want to take pictures.

Question 16.
We should arrive at the castle by 9.45. We won't be going on a guided tour because I know how bored you all get, so, instead, we will go to the gardens where we will have a special painting class; the gardens are very beautiful. All your paintings will be exhibited in the school hall next week.

Question 17.
After lunch you can have a look around the castle for an hour which will be followed by a special treat. No that doesn't mean you will go and eat cake, we will be going on a boat down the river. I know that this is a trip that you will really enjoy.

Question 18.
Now those projects I mentioned earlier will be marked by Friday afternoon so they all need to be handed in by Tuesday afternoon. Not Wednesday morning! Us poor teachers have lots to do so you must hand your projects in on time.

Question 19.
If you want more information to help you write your projects, you can look on the castle website which is www dot arundel dot castle dot com. I'll spell that for you, that's A-R-U-N-D-E-L.
OK, you can go to your lessons now.
